text:
maia: Quick: planning a slim Dedicated-capacity roadmap entry for Q2 pilot. Need final gating checklist for reserved pools + clear wording on burst.

ben: Keep it tiny. My suggested gates:
- Forecast (region, start, QPS) submitted >=14d for new pools, >=72h for upsizes
- Staging pool provisioned mirrored to prod
- Automated smoke-runner exits 0 and uploads report
- PagerDuty owner assigned for 24h cutover window
- Billing mapping confirmed (reserved vs burst vs overage)

ravi: Acceptance runner minimum: 5m steady load at forecast QPS, 95th < target, p99 within degradation budget, cache read/write smoke, and a simulated preemption check. If any fail -> rollback.

maia: Policy decisions we need leadership to pick: 1) Burst = paid opt-in SLA or default best-effort? 2) Autoscale cooldowns: platform default vs per-customer tuning?

ops-bot: Ops prefers centralized cooldowns to start. Allow override via Ops review + fee. I'll volunteer for the 24h rota for the first two pilots.

finance-bot: Finance needs explicit invoice line items. Proposal: reserved_capacity, burst_sla_addon, burst_overage_rate_per_minute.

ben: Action items: Maia to draft 1-pager; Ravi to produce runner script + example k6 snippet; Ops to add PD template; Finance to draft invoice verbiage. Target pilot in 3 weeks.

maia: Cool. I'll push draft and tag leadership on the two policy decisions.
